examples.zh: 她花了三年完成那部渔村民族志。

meaning: n. 大锅;煮皂锅

examples.en: The witch stirred a huge steaming cauldron in the story.
examples.zh: 故事里的女巫搅动着一口冒着热气的大锅。

meaning: n. 脱离, 分离

examples.en: The region narrowly voted against secession from the union.
examples.zh: 该地区以微弱多数投票反对退出联盟。

meaning: adv. 有名无实地, 名义上地, 名称上

examples.en: He is nominally the boss, but his sister decides everything.
examples.zh: 他名义上是老板，实际什么都由妹妹决定。

meaning: n. 牛奶商, 送奶工, 挤奶的男人

examples.en: The milkman leaves fresh bottles at our door before dawn.
examples.zh: 送奶工天亮前把新鲜牛奶放在家门口。

meaning: n. 困惑, 昏乱

examples.en: She stared at the complicated menu in complete bewilderment.
examples.zh: 她一脸茫然地盯着那份复杂的菜单。

meaning: n. 烛花, 用鼻吸气, 嗅, 闻, 鼻烟, 气味;vt. 剪烛花, 掐灭, 扼杀, 消灭, 用鼻吸, 嗅出, 闻出

examples.en: The old gentleman took a pinch of snuff after lunch.
examples.zh: 老绅士午饭后嗅了一小撮鼻烟。

meaning: a. <主英>=tantalizing

examples.en: The tantalising smell of fresh bread drifted from the bakery.
examples.zh: 面包房飘来新鲜面包诱人的香味。

meaning: n. 拔, 拉, 撤退

examples.en: The sofa has a pullout bed for surprise guests.
examples.zh: 这张沙发有一张供客人用的拉出床。

meaning: n. 肯尼亚人

examples.en: The Kenyan runner won the city marathon for the third time.
examples.zh: 那位肯尼亚选手第三次赢得城市马拉松。

meaning: n. 快速船

examples.en: The greyhound raced around the track in under thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 灵犬用了不到三十秒就跑完赛道。

meaning: v. 吟咏

examples.en: The monk began to intone the evening prayers slowly.
examples.zh: 僧人开始缓缓吟诵晚祷。

meaning: n. 耶鲁

examples.en: My cousin got into Yale with a full scholarship.
examples.zh: 我表哥拿着全额奖学金考入了耶鲁。

meaning: n. 录音磁带

examples.en: The detective found an old audiotape hidden in the drawer.
examples.zh: 侦探在抽屉里找到一盘藏起来的旧录音带。

meaning: n. 小孩, 少量, 合计;vi. 合计, 总计为

examples.en: The little tot waddled over to hug her mother.
examples.zh: 小娃娃摇摇晃晃地走过去抱住妈妈。

meaning: n. 荒地, 未开垦地

examples.en: The old factory site is now a rusty wasteland.
examples.zh: 旧厂区现在成了一片锈迹斑斑的荒地。

meaning: a. 容易的, 不费力气的

examples.en: Her effortless singing won over the whole audience.
examples.zh: 她毫不费力的演唱征服了全场观众。

meaning: n. 同情者, 怜悯者, 同意者, 支持者;同感眼, 交感眼

examples.en: The regime jailed every suspected sympathizer of the rebels.
examples.zh: 该政权监禁了每一位叛军的嫌疑支持者。

meaning: adv. 绝妙地, 惊奇地, 不可思议地

examples.en: The play was marvellously acted from beginning to end.
examples.zh: 这出戏从头到尾都演得精彩极了。

meaning: a. 抑制的；遏制的；控制的

examples.en: The court granted her a restraining order against him.
examples.zh: 法院向她签发了针对他的限制令。

meaning: n. 吹制工, 鼓风机, 吹风机;(鼓;吹;扇;排)风机

examples.en: The noisy leaf blower woke me up at seven.
examples.zh: 吵闹的吹叶机七点就把我吵醒了。

meaning: n. 优柔寡断;决定不能

examples.en: After much indecision, she finally chose the blue dress.
examples.zh: 犹豫再三之后她终于选定了蓝裙子。

meaning: n. 校舍

examples.en: The village schoolhouse has only one small classroom.
examples.zh: 村里的校舍只有一间小教室。

meaning: n. 发型

examples.en: Her new short hairstyle really suits her face.
examples.zh: 她的新短发很衬她的脸型。

meaning: adv. 说不清

examples.en: The lights went out inexplicably at midnight last night.
examples.zh: 昨天午夜灯莫名其妙地全灭了。

meaning: n. 北欧人, 日耳曼民族, 北欧两项滑雪;a. 北欧人的, 日耳曼民族的, 北欧两项滑雪的

examples.en: She enjoys nordic skiing in the snowy mountains every winter.
examples.zh: 她每年冬天都喜欢在雪山滑北欧式滑雪。

meaning: n. 看门人

examples.en: The doorman hailed us a taxi in the pouring rain.
examples.zh: 门童在大雨中帮我们拦了一辆出租车。

meaning: adv. 据说, 根据风评

examples.en: The old castle is reputedly haunted by a gray lady.
examples.zh: 据说那座古堡里闹灰衣女鬼。

meaning: n. 喜孤独的人, 不合群的动物

examples.en: He was a loner who preferred books to parties.
examples.zh: 他是个宁愿读书也不赴会的独行侠。

meaning: n. 隐匿, 隐藏之事, 隐匿之所, 痛打;躲藏, 躲藏处

examples.en: The scared kitten ran into hiding under the bed.
examples.zh: 受惊的小猫钻到床底下躲了起来。

meaning: n. 闪光, 遮雨板, 防水板;闪光

examples.en: We followed the flashing lights of the ambulance.
examples.zh: 我们跟着救护车闪烁的灯光前进。

meaning: vt. 激怒, 发怒, 提高价格, 吹胀;vi. 吹气, 恫吓, 发怒

examples.en: She left the room in a huff after losing.
examples.zh: 输了之后她气冲冲地离开了房间。

meaning: n. 河堤, 河岸

examples.en: We had a lovely picnic on the sunny riverbank.
examples.zh: 我们在阳光明媚的河岸上愉快地野餐。

meaning: adv. 在任何地方

examples.en: You can buy good coffee anyplace in this city.
examples.zh: 在这座城市里随处都能买到好咖啡。

meaning: a. 宇宙哲学的, 宇宙论的

examples.en: The lecture covered cosmological questions about the birth of the universe.
examples.zh: 讲座涉及关于宇宙起源的宇宙学问题。

meaning: n. 薄纱, 纱布, 金属网;纱布

examples.en: The nurse wrapped the burn in soft clean gauze.
examples.zh: 护士用柔软干净的纱布包扎烧伤处。

meaning: vt. 重新分配, 再分发;再分配, 重新分配

examples.en: The charity will redistribute the donated coats to local shelters.
examples.zh: 慈善机构将把捐赠的外套分发给当地收容所。

meaning: 串扰, 串音, 串话

examples.en: There was too much crosstalk on the video call.
examples.zh: 视频通话里的串音太严重了。

meaning: n. 共存, 和平共处, 并立

examples.en: The two neighboring states have kept peaceful coexistence for decades.
examples.zh: 这两个邻国数十年来一直保持和平共处。

meaning: n. 博学者；魔术师

examples.en: The mage cast a bright spell to light the cave.
examples.zh: 法师施展明亮的法术照亮了洞穴。

meaning: a. （选手或运动队）未被打败过的, 未输过的; 不败

examples.en: The home team finished the whole season undefeated.
examples.zh: 主队以整个赛季不败的战绩收官。

meaning: a. 新娘的, 婚礼的

examples.en: Her older sister wore a beautiful bridal gown.
examples.zh: 她姐姐穿着一件漂亮的婚纱。

meaning: a. 考虑过的, 被尊重的

examples.en: We considered taking the train instead of driving.
examples.zh: 我们考虑过坐火车而不是开车去。

meaning: a. 有条理的, 有效率的

examples.en: She answered the phone in a brisk, businesslike tone.
examples.zh: 她用干脆利落的公事口吻接了电话。

meaning: a. 无人出席的, 无随员的, 无侍从的, 无伴的, 未被注意的

examples.en: Please do not leave your bags unattended in the station.
examples.zh: 请不要把行李单独留在车站里。

meaning: a. 可移去的, 可免职的, 可移动的;可移动的

examples.en: The jacket has a removable liner for very cold days.
examples.zh: 这件夹克有一层御寒的可拆卸内衬。

meaning: n. 绿叶, 绿树, 装饰用的绿树枝或叶

examples.en: The balcony is full of lush greenery in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天阳台上满是郁郁葱葱的绿植。

meaning: n. 袋布, 麻袋布

examples.en: The coach's sudden sacking shocked the fans.
examples.zh: 教练突然被解雇，球迷们很震惊。

meaning: n. 压缩物, 压缩机, 压肌;压缩机

examples.en: The garage compressor inflates a tire in seconds.
examples.zh: 车库的压缩机几秒钟就能把轮胎打足气。

meaning: adv. 决定性地, 最后地

examples.en: The lab results definitively proved the painting was fake.
examples.zh: 化验结果最终证明那幅画是赝品。

meaning: n. 糖蜜;糖蜜; 废糖蜜

examples.en: The gingerbread recipe uses dark molasses instead of honey.
examples.zh: 这个姜饼配方用深色糖蜜代替蜂蜜。

meaning: a. 摆动的, 不稳定的

examples.en: That wobbly chair needs a new screw.
examples.zh: 那把摇晃的椅子需要换颗螺丝。

meaning: n. 幼虫, 乏味之人;v. 寻找, 翻掘

examples.en: The starling pulled a fat grub from the lawn.
examples.zh: 椋鸟从草坪里啄出一条肥幼虫。

meaning: n. 植物学家

examples.en: The botanist studies rare orchids deep in the rainforest.
examples.zh: 那位植物学家在雨林深处研究珍稀兰花。

meaning: v. 收集( collect的现在分词 ); 收到; 收藏; 聚积

examples.en: He spends weekends collecting stamps from old letters.
examples.zh: 他周末喜欢收集旧信件上的邮票。

meaning: a. 肉的, 似肉的, 多肉的

examples.en: The mushroom burger was surprisingly meaty and filling.
examples.zh: 蘑菇汉堡意外地扎实饱腹。

meaning: a. 咆哮的, 极大的, 荒凉的;n. 啸声

examples.en: The howling wind kept the whole village awake all night.
examples.zh: 呼啸的狂风让全村人一夜未眠。

meaning: n. 服饰用品商店

examples.en: The outfitter rented us canoes for the river trip.
examples.zh: 那家户外用品店租给我们独木舟去河上玩。

meaning: n. 大奖章, 圆形浮雕, 圆形装饰

examples.en: The old pilot wore a silver medallion around his neck.
examples.zh: 老飞行员脖子上戴着一块银质徽章。

meaning: n. 灰姑娘

examples.en: The ballet company performed Cinderella to great applause last weekend.
examples.zh: 芭蕾舞团上周末演出了《灰姑娘》，掌声不断。

meaning: vi. 闷烧, 郁积;n. 闷烧

examples.en: The logs smolder quietly in the fireplace until morning.
examples.zh: 木柴在壁炉里静静阴燃到天亮。

meaning: n. 跳动, 搏动;vi. 博动, 抽动, 颤动

examples.en: My sprained ankle began to throb after the game.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后我扭伤的脚踝开始阵阵作痛。

meaning: a. 特洛伊的, 特洛伊人的;n. 特洛伊人, 勤勉的人, 勇士

examples.en: The antivirus blocked a trojan hidden in the email attachment.
examples.zh: 杀毒软件拦截了藏在邮件附件里的木马。

meaning: a. 加强的

examples.en: The knights sheltered behind thick fortified castle walls.
examples.zh: 骑士们躲在高高的设防城墙后面。

meaning: n. 角膜白斑, 白眼, 散开性斜视;角膜白斑, 散开性斜视, 外斜视

examples.en: We caught a huge walleye on the lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分我们在湖里钓到一条大眼狮鲈。

meaning: n. 大众汽车（财富500强公司之一）

examples.en: My first car was a used blue Volkswagen.
examples.zh: 我的第一辆车是一辆蓝色的大众二手车。

meaning: a. 概念的, 想像的;名义上的

examples.en: The project still has only a notional budget for now.
examples.zh: 该项目目前还只有一个名义上的预算。

meaning: n. 居住, 住所

examples.en: The rocky island is unfit for human habitation.
examples.zh: 这座多岩石的岛屿不宜人类居住。

meaning: a. 令人大怒的;v. 使大怒, 激怒( infuriate的现在分词)

examples.en: The printer jammed again, which was absolutely infuriating.
examples.zh: 打印机又卡纸了，真是气死人了。

meaning: 旺兹沃思(在大伦敦郡的西南部)

examples.en: She rents a small flat in Wandsworth with a friend.
examples.zh: 她和朋友在旺兹沃思合租了一间小公寓。

meaning: n. 社会工作者

examples.en: The caseworker visits the struggling family every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 社工每周三探访那个困难家庭。

meaning: n. 理发, 美发

examples.en: She took a hairdressing course at the local college.
examples.zh: 她在本地学院上了一门美发课程。

meaning: adv. 概念地

examples.en: The task is conceptually simple but technically very hard.
examples.zh: 这项任务概念上简单，技术上却很难。

meaning: a. 不悦目的, 不雅观的, 难看的, 丑陋的

examples.en: The storm left unsightly cracks across the old wall.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把老墙面吹裂得很难看。

meaning: n. 左撇子, 左翼分子

examples.en: The team needs a lefty on the pitching staff.
examples.zh: 球队的投手组里需要一个左撇子。

meaning: vt. 使革命化, 彻底改革, 彻底改变

examples.en: Cheap electric cars could revolutionise transport in our cities.
examples.zh: 廉价的电动汽车可能彻底改变我们城市的交通。

meaning: adv. 成比例地, 相称地

examples.en: Costs rose proportionately with the size of the house.
examples.zh: 费用随着房屋面积成比例地上涨。

meaning: vt. 庇护, 资助, 赞助, 保护, 光顾, 惠顾, 对...以恩人自居

examples.en: Many locals still patronise the little bakery on the corner.
examples.zh: 许多当地人仍然光顾街角的那家小面包店。

meaning: a. 肉的, 肉体的

examples.en: The cactus stores water in its thick fleshy leaves.
examples.zh: 仙人掌用肥厚的肉质叶子储存水分。

meaning: n. 棒球手

examples.en: The young ballplayer practices swinging in the yard daily.
examples.zh: 那个年轻球员每天都在院子里练挥棒。

meaning: v. 波动, 起伏, 呈波浪形( undulate的现在分词 ); 使波动, 使起伏, 使成波浪形; 波状

examples.en: We cycled across the undulating hills of Tuscany.
examples.zh: 我们骑车穿行在托斯卡纳起伏的丘陵间。

meaning: vt. 低估...之价值, 低估, 看轻;低估, 降低...价值

examples.en: Do not undervalue the power of a good night's sleep.
examples.zh: 不要低估睡个好觉的力量。

meaning: a. 含泪的, 使人流泪的, 流泪的

examples.en: The graduates shared a long tearful goodbye on the lawn.
examples.zh: 毕业生们在草坪上含泪久久道别。

meaning: interj. 找到了, 有了;n. 优铜

examples.en: The scientist shouted 'Eureka!' when the experiment finally worked.
examples.zh: 实验终于成功时，科学家高喊“我发现了”。

meaning: n. 狂文, 铺张华丽的表演, 狂行, 狂言, 狂剧, 狂曲, 狂诗

examples.en: The city's New Year fireworks extravaganza lasts a full hour.
examples.zh: 城市的新年焰火盛典持续整整一个小时。

meaning: n. 被动, 被动性, 无抵抗, 钝性, 被动结构;钝态

examples.en: His passivity in meetings annoys all his coworkers.
examples.zh: 他在会议上的消极被动让同事们都恼火。

meaning: n. 写字, 印字, 刻字

examples.en: The shop's gold lettering shines above the old door.
examples.zh: 店铺的金色字样在老门上方闪闪发亮。

meaning: adv. 不够地, 不能胜任地

examples.en: The meat was insufficiently cooked and had to go back.
examples.zh: 那份肉没做熟，只能退回厨房。

meaning: 拧紧

examples.en: I felt a tightening in my chest before the speech.
examples.zh: 演讲前我感到胸口一阵发紧。

meaning: a. 可销售的, 销路好的, 市场的;有销路的, 可销售的

examples.en: Learning to code makes graduates more marketable to employers.
examples.zh: 会编程让毕业生更受雇主青睐。

meaning: vi. 消退；下沉；平息;vt. 资助（等于subsidize）；给...补助金

examples.en: Students can buy subsidised lunches in the school canteen.
examples.zh: 学生可以在学校食堂购买补贴午餐。

meaning: n. 石造物, 建筑物的石造部分, 石方工程, 石细工, 石匠工场, 石铺

examples.en: The church's ancient stonework was cleaned by experts last year.
examples.zh: 教堂的古老石雕去年由专家进行了清洗。

meaning: a. 沉思的, 爱默想的, 冥想的;沉思的

examples.en: She sat in a quiet contemplative mood by the lake.
examples.zh: 她在湖边静静地坐着，若有所思。

meaning: 磨光, 擦光;精制; 抛光

examples.en: He spent the whole afternoon polishing his old bicycle.
examples.zh: 他花了一下午擦拭他那辆旧自行车。

meaning: n. 大瀑布, 奔流, 暴雨, 白内障;内障, 白内障

examples.en: Grandpa's eyesight improved greatly after his cataract surgery.
examples.zh: 爷爷做完白内障手术后视力大有好转。

meaning: a. 列有标题的, 具有某种类型的头(脑)或头发的

examples.en: We headed north before the traffic got heavy.
examples.zh: 趁着还没堵车，我们先向北出发了。

meaning: n. 侵蚀, 侵犯;侵犯, 侵占, 侵入

examples.en: The new fence protects the forest from further encroachment.
examples.zh: 新围栏保护森林免遭进一步的侵占。

meaning: a. 无防御的, 没有保护的, 无助的, 无防备的

examples.en: The chicks are defenceless without their mother nearby.
examples.zh: 没有母鸟在旁，雏鸟毫无防御能力。

meaning: n. 继续, 停留, 持续;继续, 延续, 诉讼延期

examples.en: The continuance of the program depends on next year's funding.
examples.zh: 该项目能否继续取决于明年的资金。

meaning: n. 声纳;声纳

examples.en: The submarine uses sonar to map the deep seabed.
examples.zh: 潜艇利用声呐绘制深海海床图。

meaning: vt. 使变黑, 诽谤;vi. 变黑

examples.en: The smoke began to blacken the kitchen ceiling.
examples.zh: 烟开始把厨房天花板熏黑。

meaning: n. 田纳西州

examples.en: My uncle moved to Tennessee for a teaching job.
examples.zh: 我叔叔为了教书搬去了田纳西州。

meaning: a. 重复的；循环的；反复的

examples.en: The parrot kept repeating everything we said.
examples.zh: 鹦鹉不停地学说我们讲的每句话。

meaning: a. 无利益的, 不赚钱的, 不上算的;无利可图的, 无益的

examples.en: The airline closed its unprofitable routes to smaller cities.
examples.zh: 该航空公司关闭了不盈利的小城市航线。

meaning: a. 发出尖叫声的, 极滑稽的, 惊人的

examples.en: Fans were screaming as the band walked on stage.
examples.zh: 乐队登上舞台时，歌迷们尖叫不止。

meaning: n. 置放者, 推车工, 轻击棒;vi. 慢条斯理地工作, 漫步, 闲荡

examples.en: He grabbed his putter for the final shot on the green.
examples.zh: 他拿起推杆，准备在果岭上推最后一杆。

meaning: a. 独裁的, 专制的

examples.en: Voters clearly rejected his autocratic style of leadership.
examples.zh: 选民们明确拒绝了他专断的领导作风。

meaning: n. 常态

examples.en: The town slowly returned to normalcy after the flood.
examples.zh: 洪水过后，小镇慢慢恢复了正常。

meaning: a. 圆柱体的, 圆筒形的;圆柱形的, 圆柱体的, 圆筒形的, 柱面的

examples.en: The lab stores samples in cylindrical glass jars.
examples.zh: 实验室用圆柱形玻璃罐存放样本。

meaning: a. 堵塞的；被封锁的

examples.en: A fallen tree blocked the only mountain road.
examples.zh: 一棵倒下的树堵住了唯一的山路。

meaning: a. 朝上的, 翻过来的, 翻转的

examples.en: We sat on upturned crates around the campfire.
examples.zh: 我们围着篝火坐在翻过来的木箱上。

meaning: a. 机会主义的, 投机取巧的

examples.en: Seagulls are opportunistic feeders around beach picnics.
examples.zh: 海鸥是野餐桌旁见机行事的家伙。

meaning: n. 远离, 远隔, 微少;遥远, 间接, 疏远

examples.en: The cabin's remoteness makes it a perfect writing retreat.
examples.zh: 小屋的与世隔绝使它成为理想的写作静修地。

meaning: n. 山楂

examples.en: A thick hawthorn hedge borders the old garden.
examples.zh: 一道茂密的山楂树篱围着老花园。

meaning: n. 前院

examples.en: Two guards stood watching the petrol station forecourt.
examples.zh: 两名保安站在加油站前庭守望。

meaning: n. 驱集, 集拢, 综述

examples.en: The ranch starts its annual cattle roundup in May.
examples.zh: 牧场五月份开始一年一度的赶牛集合。

meaning: n. 百科全书

examples.en: Grandpa still keeps his thick old encyclopaedia on the shelf.
examples.zh: 爷爷书架上还摆着他那本厚厚的旧百科全书。

meaning: n. 胶原;骨胶原; 胶原

examples.en: The cream claims to boost collagen in aging skin.
examples.zh: 这款面霜宣称能增加成熟皮肤中的胶原蛋白。

meaning: n. 欧洲蕨

examples.en: The narrow path disappears into tall bracken in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天，窄窄的小径隐没在高高的蕨草丛中。

meaning: n. 服装模特儿, 人体模型

examples.en: The mannequin in the window wore this season's new coat.
examples.zh: 橱窗里的模特穿着本季的新款大衣。

meaning: n. 丙烷;丙烷

examples.en: We cooked breakfast on a small propane stove outside.
examples.zh: 我们在外面用小丙烷炉做了早饭。

meaning: a. 猛烈的, 发出撞击声的, 了不起的, 轰动的

examples.en: The young band gave a truly smashing performance last night.
examples.zh: 那支年轻的乐队昨晚的演出精彩极了。

meaning: n. 晾, 通风, 兜风;充气

examples.en: The documentary got its first airing on Sunday night.
examples.zh: 那部纪录片于周日晚首次播出。

meaning: n. 柬埔寨人（高棉人）；柬埔寨语

examples.en: My Cambodian friend taught me her family's noodle recipe.
examples.zh: 柬埔寨朋友教了我她家的面条做法。

meaning: a. 老年病学的, 衰老的, 老年的;老年医学的, 老年病学的, 老人学的

examples.en: Grandpa attends a geriatric clinic once a month.
examples.zh: 爷爷每个月去一次老年病门诊。

meaning: n. 简便饮食店

examples.en: A cozy little eatery near campus serves great dumplings.
examples.zh: 校园附近一家舒适的小餐馆饺子很棒。

meaning: 墨西哥胡椒

examples.en: Add some chopped jalapeno if you like it spicy.
examples.zh: 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加一点墨西哥辣椒碎。

meaning: 子测验(程序教学用语)

examples.en: She scored highest on the math subtest this year.
examples.zh: 她在数学分测验中得了最高分。

meaning: n. 磨, 制粉, 轧齿边;混炼

examples.en: Hundreds of fans were milling around outside the concert hall.
examples.zh: 数百名歌迷在音乐厅外转来转去。

meaning: n. 辩论, 恳请, 答辩, 诉讼手续, 诉状;a. 恳求的

examples.en: The boy gave his mother a pleading look for candy.
examples.zh: 男孩用恳求的眼神看着妈妈要糖吃。

meaning: a. 不疲倦的, 不厌倦的, 不屈不挠的

examples.en: The nurse was tireless through the long night shift.
examples.zh: 那位护士在整个漫长的夜班里不知疲倦。

meaning: n. 光点, 清脆的短音;小粒

examples.en: The doctor said the fever was just a brief blip.
examples.zh: 医生说这次发烧只是个小插曲。

meaning: v. 憎恨( hate的过去式和过去分词 ); 讨厌; 不愿; 为…感到抱歉

examples.en: He hated doing homework on sunny weekend mornings.
examples.zh: 他讨厌在晴朗的周末早晨写作业。

meaning: n. 灰烬, 余烬

examples.en: A single ember still glowed in the fireplace at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜时壁炉里还有一块余烬在发光。

meaning: adv. 违反习俗地; 不自然地; 勉强地; 不近人情地

examples.en: The office was unnaturally quiet on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周五下午的办公室安静得出奇。

meaning: vt. 使发扑通声, 沉重地坠落;vi. 发扑通声, 支持

examples.en: She let her heavy bag plunk down onto the bench.
examples.zh: 她让沉重的包扑通一声落在长椅上。

meaning: n. 精液, 精子;种子; 精液

examples.en: The clinic stores semen samples in special frozen tanks.
examples.zh: 诊所把精液样本保存在特制的冷冻罐里。

meaning: a. 五旬节的, 五旬节派教会的

examples.en: The choir sang at a busy Pentecostal church downtown.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在市区一家热闹的五旬节教会演唱。

meaning: a. 广泛的; 普遍的; 非具体的; 整体的

examples.en: The report gave only a generalised picture of the problem.
examples.zh: 这份报告只对问题作了概括性的描述。

meaning: adv. 电力地；有关电地

examples.en: The car is powered electrically, so it runs almost silently.
examples.zh: 这辆车靠电力驱动，行驶时几乎无声。

meaning: a. 个人主义的, 独特的

examples.en: American culture is often described as loudly individualistic.
examples.zh: 美国文化常被形容为张扬的个人主义。

meaning: n. 测量;测量的

examples.en: She was carefully measuring flour for the birthday cake.
examples.zh: 她正在仔细地为生日蛋糕称量面粉。

meaning: a. 未被改变的, 不变的, 照旧的, 依然如此的

examples.en: The mountain village has remained unaltered for a century.
examples.zh: 这个山村百年来一直保持原样。

meaning: n. 视觉, 视力, 观看;conj. 鉴于

examples.en: Seeing that it's getting late, let's take a taxi home.
examples.zh: 鉴于天色已晚，我们打车回家吧。

meaning: n. 售货员,店员

examples.en: The store trains all its salespeople every autumn.
examples.zh: 这家商店每年秋天培训全体销售员。

meaning: a. 迷人的, 妩媚的, 迷惑人的

examples.en: The ballet was absolutely enchanting from start to finish.
examples.zh: 这部芭蕾舞剧从头到尾都令人陶醉。

meaning: n. 完全;完整性

examples.en: The auditor checked the completeness of every single record.
examples.zh: 审计员检查了每一条记录的完整性。

meaning: n. 家长统治, 父权制, 男性政体;家长制, 父权制, 父系社会

examples.en: The novel explores family life under a strict patriarchy.
examples.zh: 这部小说探讨了严格父权制下的家庭生活。

meaning: n. 贝雷帽

examples.en: The artist wore a black beret at the gallery opening.
examples.zh: 艺术家在画廊开幕式上戴着一顶黑色贝雷帽。

meaning: n. 刺刀

examples.en: The antique rifle still has its original bayonet.
examples.zh: 那支古董步枪还保留着原装刺刀。

meaning: a. 结霜的, 冻伤的, 无光泽的, 磨砂的, 因年老而变白的, 冷淡的

examples.en: She drew a little heart on the frosted window.
examples.zh: 她在结霜的窗户上画了一颗小爱心。

meaning: n. 住所, 住处;abide的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: Welcome to my humble abode, my friend.
examples.zh: 欢迎来到寒舍，请随便坐。

meaning: n. 杨树, 杨木;杨属植物(通常指白杨)

examples.en: A tall poplar sways outside my bedroom window.
examples.zh: 我卧室窗外一棵高高的白杨在摇曳。

meaning: n. 百慕大岛

examples.en: She packed only light clothes for her Bermuda vacation.
examples.zh: 她为百慕大之旅只带了轻薄的衣服。

meaning: a. 骨盆的;骨盆的

examples.en: The therapist taught her simple pelvic floor exercises.
examples.zh: 治疗师教了她简单的盆底肌练习。

meaning: v. 不见, 消失( disappear的现在分词 ); 不复存在; 掩始; 隐显

examples.en: Old phone booths are disappearing from city streets.
examples.zh: 老式电话亭正从城市街头逐渐消失。

meaning: a. 无可争辩的, 无异议的;无需争论的, 无疑问的, 确然无疑的

examples.en: She is the undisputed champion of table tennis here.
examples.zh: 她是这里无可争议的乒乓球冠军。

meaning: n. 公用场地；有树丛的开阔草地

examples.en: The estate includes acres of rolling green parkland.
examples.zh: 这座庄园拥有绵延数英亩的园林绿地。

meaning: a. 不显著的, 平凡的, 不值得注意的

examples.en: An unremarkable dirt road leads to the hidden beach.
examples.zh: 一条不起眼的土路通向隐秘的海滩。

meaning: 起泡, 生泡;发疱, 发疱的

examples.en: The runners trained through the blistering heat of July.
examples.zh: 跑步选手们在七月的酷暑中坚持训练。

meaning: n. 亚利桑那州

examples.en: My sister studies astronomy at a university in Arizona.
examples.zh: 我妹妹在亚利桑那州的一所大学学天文学。

meaning: a. 钢的, 钢制的, 钢铁般的

examples.en: The captain spoke with steely calm during the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴中船长以钢铁般的镇定开口说话。

meaning: n. 卵巢, 子房, 果核;卵巢, 子房

examples.en: The ultrasound showed a perfectly healthy ovary.
examples.zh: 超声检查显示卵巢完全健康。

meaning: a. （水）平扁的, 弄平的;v. 变平, 使（某物）变平( flatten的过去式和过去分词 ); 彻底打败某人, 使丢脸; 停止增长（或上升）; （把身体或

examples.en: The small tent flattened under last night's heavy snow.
examples.zh: 昨夜的大雪把小帐篷压塌了。

meaning: vt. 容纳过多的人, 使过度拥挤

examples.en: Summer flights quickly overcrowd the tiny island airport.
examples.zh: 夏季航班让这座小岛机场迅速变得拥挤。

meaning: a. 可怕的, 极讨厌的, 毛骨悚然的

examples.en: The hotel food was horrid, cold and completely tasteless.
examples.zh: 酒店的饭菜又冷又没味，难吃极了。

meaning: n. 帏帐, 布料

examples.en: Heavy velvet drapery hung across the theater stage.
examples.zh: 剧院的舞台前挂着厚重的天鹅绒帷幔。

meaning: n. 圆石, 鹅卵石

examples.en: We strolled hand in hand down the cobblestone street.
examples.zh: 我们手牵手漫步在鹅卵石街道上。

meaning: vt. 超过...速度, 赶过

examples.en: Demand for housing continues to outpace supply.
examples.zh: 住房需求持续超过供给。

meaning: adv. 愉快地, 高兴地

examples.en: The children sang merrily all the way to school.
examples.zh: 孩子们一路欢快地唱着歌去上学。

meaning: adv. 惆怅地, 渴望地

examples.en: She gazed wistfully at photos of her childhood home.
examples.zh: 她惆怅地凝视着童年老宅的照片。

meaning: vt. 使中立化, 使成为无效;vt.vi. 抵销, (使)中和

examples.en: Baking soda can neutralise the acid in the tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 小苏打可以中和番茄酱汁里的酸味。

meaning: n. 优先权, 舞步, 舞;光声谱法; 光声光谱法

examples.en: The ballet's final pas drew thunderous applause.
examples.zh: 芭蕾舞剧的最后一段舞步赢得了雷鸣般的掌声。

meaning: n. 说服, 安抚, 抚慰, 调和;调解

examples.en: The union and the company finally entered conciliation talks.
examples.zh: 工会和公司最终进入了调解谈判。

meaning: 连接, 链接

examples.en: Try linking the last two ideas in your essay.
examples.zh: 试着把文章里的最后两个观点衔接起来。

meaning: vt. 使受损伤, 使受精神创伤

examples.en: A painful dentist visit can traumatize a small child.
examples.zh: 一次痛苦的看牙经历可能会让幼儿留下心理阴影。

meaning: a. 痛的, 苦恼的, 伤感情的, 表示怨恨的

examples.en: He gave a pained smile when asked about his knee.
examples.zh: 被问到膝盖时，他挤出一个痛苦的微笑。

meaning: v. 系（tie的过去式和过去分词）

examples.en: She tied the satin ribbon around the gift box.
examples.zh: 她把缎带系在礼盒上。

meaning: n. 镶板, 格子

examples.en: The library's oak panelling smells faintly of old books.
examples.zh: 图书馆的橡木护墙板散发着淡淡的旧书气味。

meaning: adv. 浪费地, 丰富地

examples.en: The palace ballroom is lavishly decorated with gold leaf.
examples.zh: 宫殿舞厅用金箔装饰得极为奢华。

meaning: a. 中魔法的; 着了魔的; 狂喜的; 极乐的;v. 使欣喜, 使心醉（ enchant的过去式和过去分词 ）; 用魔法迷惑

examples.en: The misty forest felt enchanted in the early morning.
examples.zh: 清晨薄雾中的森林宛如仙境。

meaning: n. 铁手套, 长手套, 夹击;手套形绷带

examples.en: The knight picked up the gauntlet and accepted the duel.
examples.zh: 骑士拾起铁手套，接受了决斗。

meaning: n. 大麻烟卷, 大麻, 麻类植物;大麻

examples.en: Her market bag is made of woven hemp fiber.
examples.zh: 她的买菜包是用麻纤维编织的。

meaning: a. 已被定罪的, 定了罪的人用的

examples.en: The old bridge was condemned after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震后那座旧桥被判定为危桥。

meaning: a. 令人羡慕的, 可羡慕的

examples.en: She has an enviable gift for learning languages quickly.
examples.zh: 她快速学语言的天赋令人羡慕。

meaning: a. 可爱的, 适于搂抱的, 喜欢拥抱的, 可拥抱的

examples.en: The panda cub looks like a soft cuddly toy.
examples.zh: 熊猫幼崽看上去像个柔软的毛绒玩具。

meaning: n. 游手好闲的人, 懒人, 懒汉鞋;无业游民, 不务正业者, 二流子

examples.en: He slipped on his brown leather loafers for the party.
examples.zh: 聚会前他蹬上了棕色皮乐福鞋。

meaning: v. (使)下马;卸除卷

examples.en: The gymnast must dismount cleanly to earn a high score.
examples.zh: 体操运动员必须干净利落地落地才能得高分。

meaning: a. （英）个人化的（等于personalized）

examples.en: The shop sells personalised mugs printed with your name.
examples.zh: 那家店卖印有你自己名字的定制马克杯。

meaning: n. 花花公子, 情郎, 求爱者

examples.en: She brought her new beau to the family dinner.
examples.zh: 她带着新男友来参加家宴。

meaning: a. 浓缩的；强化的

examples.en: Her year abroad greatly enriched her view of the world.
examples.zh: 海外的一年极大地丰富了她的世界观。

meaning: n. 独身;独身状态, 独身生活

examples.en: The monk took lifelong vows of poverty and celibacy.
examples.zh: 那位僧人立下了终生守贫与独身的誓言。

meaning: a. 纪念的

examples.en: The mint issued a commemorative coin for the city's founding.
examples.zh: 造币厂为建城纪念发行了一枚纪念币。

meaning: n. 看门人

examples.en: The secretary acts as the gatekeeper to the busy director.
examples.zh: 秘书充当着通向忙碌总监的把关人。

meaning: n. 催促者, 拉客的人, 骗子;乱推乱挤的人, 非法赚钱的

examples.en: The young hustler sold newspapers on the busy corner.
examples.zh: 那个劲头十足的小伙子在热闹的街角卖报。

meaning: n. 密西西比河, 密西西比州

examples.en: We took a paddle wheeler down the Mississippi at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分我们乘明轮船游览密西西比河。

meaning: n. 踏错, 错误, 失策;失足, 过失, 失策

examples.en: One costly marketing misstep lost the brand many customers.
examples.zh: 一次代价高昂的营销失误让品牌失去众多客户。

meaning: n. 恋童癖者

examples.en: The news reported the arrest of a suspected pedophile.
examples.zh: 新闻报道了一名恋童癖嫌疑人被捕。

meaning: v. 逃走, 逃掉( flee的现在分词 ); 逃离, 逃避

examples.en: Refugees were fleeing across the border throughout the night.
examples.zh: 整夜里难民们不断越过边境逃难。

meaning: a. (像)拿破仑一世的,拿破仑一世式的,拿破仑一世时期的,拿破仑一家的

examples.en: The novel is set in France during the Napoleonic era.
examples.zh: 这部小说以拿破仑时代的法国为背景。

meaning: v. （退一步）承认( grant的现在分词 ); （尤指正式地或法律上）同意; 准许; 让渡

examples.en: The committee is granting funds to promising young researchers.
examples.zh: 委员会正在向有前途的年轻研究者发放经费。

meaning: n. 障碍滑雪

examples.en: She won gold in the giant slalom last winter.
examples.zh: 她在去年冬天的大回转滑雪赛中夺金。

meaning: n. 扭, 拧;vt. 夺取, 猛扭, 歪曲, 费力取得

examples.en: Police had to wrest the knife from the man's hand.
examples.zh: 警察不得不从那名男子手中夺下刀子。

meaning: n. 嘎嚓声;vi. 发出嘎嚓声, 嘎嚓响着前进

examples.en: The little mountain train began to chug up the slope.
examples.zh: 小火车突突地喷着汽爬上山坡。

meaning: adv. 动人地, 迷人地

examples.en: The dishes were attractively arranged on white porcelain plates.
examples.zh: 菜肴被美观地摆放在白瓷盘上。

meaning: n. 红灯笼辣椒, 红椒色;辣椒

examples.en: Sprinkle a little paprika on the roasted potatoes.
examples.zh: 给烤土豆撒上一点红椒粉。

meaning: n. 块菌

examples.en: The homemade pasta is finished with shaved black truffle.
examples.zh: 手工意面上刨了黑松露片。

meaning: light的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: A single candle lit the entire room.
examples.zh: 一支蜡烛照亮了整个房间。

meaning: n. 调情, 寄情, 求婚

examples.en: The romance film handles its lovemaking scenes with great tenderness.
examples.zh: 这部爱情片处理亲密戏份十分温柔。

meaning: a. （法）好的

examples.en: We wished the young couple bon voyage at the airport.
examples.zh: 我们在机场祝这对年轻夫妇一路平安。

meaning: n. 绿林, 湿材

examples.en: The old legend says Robin Hood lived in the greenwood.
examples.zh: 古老传说讲罗宾汉住在绿林之中。

meaning: 扫描;断续言语, 扫描

examples.en: The nervous guard kept scanning the crowd at the gate.
examples.zh: 紧张的保安在大门口不停地扫视人群。

meaning: a. （房间）有护墙板的; （墙、门或窗）镶有嵌板的

examples.en: The study has dark panelled walls and a cozy fireplace.
examples.zh: 书房有深色护墙板和温暖的壁炉。

meaning: n. 详述, 吟诵, 背诵的诗;叙述, 评述, 书面陈述

examples.en: Each student gave a recitation of a famous poem.
examples.zh: 每个学生都背诵了一首名诗。

meaning: 限局性的

examples.en: The storm damage was localised to a few coastal towns.
examples.zh: 暴风造成的破坏仅限于几座沿海小镇。

meaning: n. 度假者

examples.en: The little beach was packed with holidaymakers in July.
examples.zh: 七月的小海滩挤满了度假的人。

meaning: n. (衣饰上的)皱边, 皱边纸饰;vi. 起边皱

examples.en: The summer dress has a delicate frill around the neckline.
examples.zh: 这条夏裙的领口有一圈细巧的褶边。

meaning: a. 方向的

examples.en: The airport installed new directional signs for international travelers.
examples.zh: 机场为国际旅客安装了新的方向指示牌。

meaning: a. 有经验的, 熟练的, 精通的

examples.en: She answered the tricky question with practiced ease.
examples.zh: 她以老练的从容回答了那个刁钻的问题。

meaning: a. 灌足酒的；患踵炎症的；醉的；加过润滑脂的

examples.en: He greased the pan before pouring in the batter.
examples.zh: 他先给锅抹了油，再倒入面糊。

meaning: n. 坚质棉布

examples.en: I could hear the soft ticking of the old clock.
examples.zh: 我能听见老钟轻轻的滴答声。

meaning: n. 浪漫主义精神, 浪漫主义

examples.en: The course covers romanticism in nineteenth century European painting.
examples.zh: 这门课讲十九世纪欧洲绘画中的浪漫主义。

meaning: a. 傲慢的, 主人派头的, 熟练的

meaning: 滑动器

examples.en: Drag the volume slider to adjust the sound.
examples.zh: 拖动音量滑块来调节声音。

meaning: a. 可爱的, 惹人爱的

examples.en: The puppy is naughty but utterly lovable.
examples.zh: 小狗虽然调皮却十分惹人喜爱。

meaning: n. 非常讨厌, 嫌恶, 极不情愿

examples.en: She felt a deep loathing for crowded shopping malls.
examples.zh: 她对拥挤的商场深感厌恶。

meaning: 手淫

examples.en: The health teacher answered questions about masturbation honestly.
examples.zh: 健康课老师坦诚地解答了关于自慰的疑问。

meaning: n. 男妓；靠妓女为生的人, 为妓女拉客的人

examples.en: The gritty drama features a ponce in 1960s London.
examples.zh: 这部冷峻剧刻画了六十年代伦敦的一名皮条客。

meaning: vt.vi. (使)一般化, 从...引出一般性结论, 泛论, 概括出, 归纳出, 使广义化

examples.en: It is unfair to generalise from one bad experience.
examples.zh: 仅凭一次糟糕的经历就以偏概全是不公平的。

meaning: n. 非中心区, 住宅区;a. 住宅区的

examples.en: We took the bus uptown to visit the museum.
examples.zh: 我们乘公交去上城区参观博物馆。

meaning: a. 充满强烈感情的, 带电的, 气氛紧张的

examples.en: The room felt charged with excitement before the big show.
examples.zh: 大秀开始前，房间里充满了兴奋的气氛。

meaning: a. 整形术的, 整形学的

examples.en: The runner saw an orthopaedic surgeon about her knee.
examples.zh: 那位跑者因膝盖问题看了骨科医生。

meaning: a. 急动的, 抽筋的, 不平稳的;n. 牛肉干

examples.en: He packed beef jerky and water for the long hike.
examples.zh: 他为长途徒步带了牛肉干和水。

meaning: n. 贵族

examples.en: The wealthy nobleman invited the entire village to the feast.
examples.zh: 那位富有的贵族邀请全村人参加宴会。

meaning: a. 未被充分代表的

examples.en: Women remain underrepresented in many engineering programs.
examples.zh: 在许多工科专业里女性比例仍然偏低。

meaning: pron. （作动词或介词的宾语时, 有时候用来替代whoever）

examples.en: Give the spare tickets to whomever you like.
examples.zh: 多余的票你想给谁都行。

meaning: n. 爆发, 越狱, 突围;中断, 断裂

examples.en: The band scored a breakout hit with its second single.
examples.zh: 这支乐队凭借第二支单曲一炮走红。

meaning: 孤独的, 自我中心的

examples.en: My autistic son sees the world in wonderful ways.
examples.zh: 我患有自闭症的儿子用奇妙的方式看世界。

meaning: n. 激起行为(或行动)的人(或事物),促进因素, 激发因素

examples.en: Curiosity is the best motivator for learning something new.
examples.zh: 好奇心是学习新事物的最佳动力。

meaning: n. 正义, 公正, 正直

examples.en: He spoke with the righteousness of a true believer.
examples.zh: 他以虔信者的正义口吻高谈阔论。

meaning: 恒星飞船

examples.en: The crew explored strange planets on a fast starship.
examples.zh: 船员们驾驶快速星舰探索陌生的行星。

meaning: a. 首要的;v. 在…上方成拱形( overarch的现在分词 )

examples.en: The overarching goal of the plan is cleaner air.
examples.zh: 该计划的总体目标是更清洁的空气。

meaning: vt. 展开, 展示, 公开, 使临风招展;vi. 打开, 展开, 显露

examples.en: The sailors helped unfurl the huge white sails.
examples.zh: 水手们帮忙展开了巨大的白帆。

meaning: n. 军用飞机

examples.en: A vintage warplane flew low over the memorial ceremony.
examples.zh: 一架老式战机低空飞过纪念仪式。

meaning: a. 音调的, 色调的

examples.en: The painter worked within a narrow tonal range of blues.
examples.zh: 画家在狭窄的蓝色调范围内作画。

meaning: a. 不容忍的, 不容异说的, 偏执的, 偏狭的, 不宽容的, 不耐的, 不耐性的

examples.en: He is intolerant of any noise while he writes.
examples.zh: 他写作时无法忍受任何一点噪音。

meaning: n. 麻疹, 风疹, 家畜囊尾蚴病, 米珠;麻疹, 囊尾蚴病(家畜)

examples.en: The child stayed home from school with measles.
examples.zh: 那个孩子因患麻疹而待在家里。

meaning: n. 润肤霜; 保湿霜

examples.en: Apply moisturizer daily to protect dry winter skin.
examples.zh: 每天涂润肤霜来保护干燥的冬季皮肤。

meaning: n. 奶油冻;摩丝(日化)

examples.en: She topped the chocolate mousse with fresh raspberries.
examples.zh: 她在巧克力慕斯上放了新鲜的树莓。

meaning: n. 残缺, 畸形, 残缺者;变形, 畸形

examples.en: The rescue puppy was born with a minor leg deformity.
examples.zh: 获救的小狗出生时腿部有轻微畸形。

meaning: n. 六月禾, 早熟禾熟植物

examples.en: We danced to live bluegrass music all evening.
examples.zh: 我们整晚随着现场蓝草音乐起舞。

meaning: n. 吸, 吸入, 吸上, 吸引, 吸力;吸气; 吸入

examples.en: The plumber used strong suction to clear the blocked pipe.
examples.zh: 水管工用强吸力疏通了堵塞的管道。

meaning: vt. 使社会化, 使社会主义化, 使适合社会需要;vi. (美)(非正式)参加社交活动, 发生社交往来

examples.en: New students can socialise at the welcome party.
examples.zh: 新生们可以在迎新会上社交联谊。

meaning: n. 优秀策划者, 才子;vt. 指导, 主持, 策划

examples.en: The police finally caught the mastermind behind the art theft.
examples.zh: 警方终于抓获了艺术盗窃案的幕后主谋。
